source: User-approved Chinese draft in this chat, 2026-10-26. Existing five patient captions remain unchanged.
scope: Every indexed patient bundle stores the pre-incision line in reaction_lines.incision_ready. Where a matching CG exists, its caption also shows the same line. Three CG assets remain pending; no new CG or trigger was created.

entries.zh: 「等等……别靠过来！我、我没办法看着这个……！」
entries.en: Wait... Don't bring it closer! I-I can't watch this...!

entries.zh: 「不……不行！对不起，求您先把刀移开……！」
entries.en: No... I can't! I'm sorry, please move the knife away...!
entries.original_caption: 器械已经递到手中，手术刀停在东川杏子预定切口的上方。
entries.original_english_caption: The instrument has been passed over, and the scalpel is poised above Kyoko Higashikawa's planned incision site.

entries.zh: 「那、那把刀……不要！我还没准备好啊……！」
entries.en: Th-that knife... No! I'm not ready yet...!
entries.original_caption: 器械已经递到坂口医生手中，手术刀停在香田映见预定切口的上方。
entries.original_english_caption: The instrument has been passed to Dr. Sakaguchi, and the scalpel is poised above Emi Koda's planned incision site.

entries.zh: 「我会……不、不行！医生，我真的好怕……！」
entries.en: I'll... N-no, I can't! Doctor, I'm so scared...!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀已经准备就绪，停在蒂法·洛克哈特预定切口的上方。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel is ready, poised above Tifa Lockhart's planned incision site.

entries.zh: 「等、等等！我没在开玩笑……先别切，求你！」
entries.en: W-wait! I'm not joking... Don't cut yet, please!
entries.original_caption: 爱丽丝·盖恩斯巴勒 · 下刀瞬间
entries.original_english_caption: Aerith Gainsborough · Incision

entries.zh: 「别过来！等一下啊！我说了等一下……！」
entries.en: Don't come closer! Wait! I said wait...!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀沿预定切口落下，天手让叶进入正式手术阶段。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel follows the planned incision as Amate Yuzuriha enters the formal operative phase.

entries.zh: 「……不要。不要……！求你，先别切……！」
entries.en: ...No. No...! Please, don't cut yet...!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀沿预定切口落下，妮安进入正式手术阶段。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel descends along the planned incision as Nyaan enters the operation proper.

entries.zh: 「明、明白……不，等等！我现在没办法……！」
entries.en: U-understood... No, wait! I can't do this right now...!

entries.zh: 「刀已经……等等！我听不进去了，先别开始！」
entries.en: The knife's already... Wait! I can't take any of this in. Don't start yet!
entries.original_caption: 瑟法 · 下刀前
entries.original_english_caption: Sepha · Before incision

entries.zh: 「我没……啊！别、别切！我怕了，真的怕了！」
entries.en: I'm not... Ah! D-don't cut! I'm scared, I'm really scared!
entries.original_caption: 槇村香 · 下刀
entries.original_english_caption: Kaori Makimura · Incision

entries.zh: 「等一下……先把刀移开。求你，我没在说笑……！」
entries.en: Wait... Move the knife away first. Please, I'm not joking...!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀来到预定切口处，野上冴子等待团队开始手术。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel reaches the planned incision site as Saeko Nogami waits for the team to begin.

entries.zh: 「我知道……可是、可是先别切！让我缓一下……！」
entries.en: I know... But-but don't cut yet! Give me a moment...!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀来到预定切口处，蝴蝶忍等待手术开始。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel reaches the planned incision site as Shinobu Kocho waits for the operation to begin.

entries.zh: 「对不起！我控制不住……先别切，求您了！」
entries.en: I'm sorry! I can't help it... Don't cut yet, please!
entries.original_caption: 麻醉状态核对完成，手术刀来到岩井善美预定切口上方。
entries.original_english_caption: After the anesthesia check, the scalpel is poised above Yoshimi Iwai's planned incision site.

entries.zh: 「真的要切进来了……？不要！等一下，等一下啊！」
entries.en: You're really going to cut into me...? No! Wait, please wait!
entries.original_caption: 手术刀已递交，团队完成最后确认，手术即将开始。
entries.original_english_caption: The scalpel is ready, the final checks are complete, and the operation is about to begin.

entries.zh: 「医生！医生……先别动刀，我真的撑不住……！」
entries.en: Doctor! Doctor... Don't use the knife yet. I really can't handle this...!
entries.original_caption: 在患者保持清醒的麻醉路径中，团队依照既定切口开始手术。
entries.original_english_caption: While the patient remains conscious under a non-general anesthesia pathway, the team begins the planned incision.

entries.zh: 「啊、不行不行！那是真的刀……先拿开，拜托！」
entries.en: Ah, no, no! That's a real knife... Move it away, please!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，清水伊莱莎在正式下刀前等待主刀确认。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse hands over the scalpel, and Iraiza Shimizu waits for the surgeon's confirmation before the incision.

entries.zh: 「不要……！我以为自己可以的……求你，等一下！」
entries.en: No...! I thought I could do this... Please, wait!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，麻生优子等待主刀确认后开始切开。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse hands over the scalpel, and Yuko Asou waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the incision.

entries.zh: 「我、我会不动……啊！先别切！我好害怕……！」
entries.en: I-I'll stay still... Ah! Don't cut yet! I'm so scared...!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，毛利兰等待主刀确认后开始切开。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse hands over the scalpel, and Ran Mouri waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the incision.

entries.zh: 「停！先停一下！我不是闹……我真的怕了！」
entries.en: Stop! Just stop a moment! I'm not making a scene... I'm really scared!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，樱井真弓等待主刀确认后开始切开。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse hands over the scalpel as Mayumi Sakurai waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the incision.

entries.zh: 「啊！别拿过来！我不敢看……也不敢闭眼啊！」
entries.en: Ah! Don't bring it closer! I'm scared to look... but I'm scared to close my eyes too!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，尤菲·如月在正式开始前等待主刀确认。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse passes the scalpel, and Yuffie Kisaragi waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the operation begins.

entries.zh: 「不行，我不行！求你先拿开……我不逞强了！」
entries.en: I can't, I can't! Please move it away... I'm done pretending to be brave!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，琪里耶·卡南在正式开始前等待主刀确认。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse passes the scalpel, and Kyrie Canaan waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the operation begins.

entries.zh: 「……别动，我不能动……啊！医生，先别切……！」
entries.en: ...Stay still. I mustn't move... Ah! Doctor, don't cut yet...!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，霞在正式开始前等待主刀确认。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse passes the scalpel, and Kasumi waits for the lead surgeon's confirmation before the operation begins.

entries.zh: 「等等……不要！我装不下去了……求你先停一下！」
entries.en: Wait... No! I can't keep up the act... Please stop a moment!

entries.zh: 「坂口！等、等等……我知道，可我还是怕！先别切！」
entries.en: Sakaguchi! W-wait... I know, but I'm still scared! Don't cut yet!
entries.original_caption: 器械护士递上手术刀，南条小夜香在正式下刀前等待主刀确认。
entries.original_english_caption: The scrub nurse hands over the scalpel, and Sayaka Nanjo waits for the surgeon's confirmation before the incision.
